```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# load necessary libraries
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)

```

## Load Data

```{r load_data}

dds = readRDS("ec_bulk_dds_obj.rds")

```


## Normalization

```{r}

# normalize counts via variance stabilizing transformation 
dds_norm <- vst(dds)
dds_norm$region <- factor(dds_norm$region,levels = c("LEC","intEC","MEC"))
dds_norm$BiologicalReplicate = factor(dds_norm$BiologicalReplicate)

```

## Generate PCA Plot


```{r generate_pca}


# create PCA
p1 <- plotPCA(
  dds_norm,
  intgroup = "BiologicalReplicate"
) + 
  theme_classic() +  # Remove grey background
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#4CC9F0", "#94bd51", "#E76BE3")) + # Set custom colors for each region
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    #panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 5, stroke = 1)  # Increase size, keep stroke small

p2 <- plotPCA(
  dds_norm,
  intgroup = "region"
) + 
  theme_classic() +  # Remove grey background
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#4CC9F0", "#94bd51", "#E76BE3")) + # Set custom colors for each region
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    #panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 5, stroke = 1)  # Increase size, keep stroke small
  

print(p1)
print(p2)


```
